notes.title: rTexPacker 5.0
notes.content:
Official release for [i]rTexPacker v5.0[/i]. Features on this release:
[list][*][i]ADDED[/i]: New UI visual style: [b]Genesis[/b][/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: Support sprite(s) [b]tag name[/b][/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: Support sprite(s) [b]manual positioning[/b][/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: Support sprite(s) [b]slicing by alpha[/b][/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: Support [b]per-sprite trimming[/b][/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: Support sprite(s) [b]collider definition[/b][/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: [b]Sprite list view[/b] with names[/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: Exporting [b]new sprite properties[/b]: tag, collider...[/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: CLI: [b]Sprite slicing[/b] support[/*][*][i]ADDED[/i]: CLI: [b]Show unpacked sprites info[/b][/*][*][i]REDESIGNED[/i]: Sprite view window, [b]added sprite tools[/b][/*][*][i]REDESIGNED[/i]: [b]RTP file-format[/b], load/save atlas config[/*][*][i]REVIEWED[/i]: [b]Initialization config options[/b][/*][*][i]REVIEWED[/i]: Sprite [b]grid view panel[/b][/*][*][i]REVIEWED[/i]: [b]Status bar info[/b], show more data[/*][*][i]REVIEWED[/i]: Only redraw render texture when required (disabled)[/*][*][i]REMOVED[/i]: Sprite shaders (needs redesign)[/*][*][i]UPDATED[/i]: Using raylib 5.6-dev and raygui 4.5-dev[/*][/list]
Enjoy [i]rTexPacker[/i]!

notes.title: rTexPacker v4.0
notes.content:
Official release for [i]rTexPacker v4.0[/i]. Features on this release:

 - [i]ADDED[/i]: [b]New welcome/about window[/b]
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: [b]Sprite multi-selection[/b] on atlas and sprite-list
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: Sprite [b]origin positions selector[/b] from list
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: [b]Configuration file[/b] support: config.ini
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: Sprite [b]shader support[/b] (experimental)
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: Sprite [b]index movement[/b] left-right inside list
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: Support forced [b]font monospace width[/b] option
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: Support [code single].rtp[/i] image [b]data compressed[/b] by default
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: [b]New UI style[/b] available: [code single]amber[/i]
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: Clear sprite list confirmation message box
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: New atlas confirmation message box
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: Sprite shader toggle shortcut (J)
 - [i]ADDED[/i]: CLI: Parameter to force font monospace width
 - [i]REMOVED[/i]: Texture scale filter toggle
 - [i]REMOVED[/i]: Clear screen button and logic
 - [i]REVIEWED[/i]: [b]Origin edit shortcut[/b] key (G)
 - [i]REVIEWED[/i]: Sprites view window to fill all height
 - [i]REVIEWED[/i]: Help window to add latest shortcuts
 - [i]REVIEWED[/i]: Help window to recenter properly
 - [i]REVIEWED[/i]: [b]Mouse wheel zoom to mouse position[/b]
 - [i]REVIEWED[/i]: CLI: Load directory files recursively
 - [i]UPDATED[/i]: UI styles to support Latin-1 Ext
 - [i]UPDATED[/i]: Using [b]raygui 4.5-dev[/b] and [b]raylib 5.5-dev[/b]

Enjoy [i]rTexPacker[/i]!
